lines: (The ground in front of you bulges... and a girl made of leaves pops up, showering soil everywhere.) Oh! Hello! Sorry about the dirt.
I travel underground. It's quicker, and the worms give very good directions.
I'm Sprout! I grow wherever I'm needed. And this is Snappy.
(The flytrap on her arm opens wide and goes SNAP!)
Snappy, manners! ...She's friendly, really. She only eats bugs. And sometimes socks.
Bramble lets me help in the gardens. I wiggle my roots in, and everything grows a little happier.
Roots are like friends. You can't always see them, but they're the ones holding you up.
(Sprout has her face turned up to the light, eyes closed, smiling.) Mmm. Sunshine is my breakfast.
Photosynthesis! It's a big word that means "yum".
Want to see how I get about? Watch the ground!
(She dives into the soil with a little twirl and pops up a few steps away.) Ta-daa!
When I'm under there, everything's quiet and cosy. Then I come up and say hello to the sky again.
At night I plant myself in the gardens and dream about rain. Gentle rain. Not the splashy kind.

rotate: (Snappy snaps at a passing firefly. Misses.) She's still learning. We all are!
Whenever I feel wobbly, I think about my roots. Deep down, nice and steady. You've got roots too, you know. Your friends. Your home.
Melody sings to my flowers every evening. I think they like the high notes best.
The dewdrops on my antlers? I save them for thirsty bees.
